method: Isolated headless Edge. Existing QA entry fixtures select Acts I to III. Real keyboard input folds and unfolds. Act IV uses its existing QA entry page. Native Web Audio calls and read-only diagnostics are observed. No game rule or audio policy is mocked.
results: Act 1 keyboard fold changes the real field count
Act 1 keyboard unfold removes the real field
Act 1 ShiftLeft retains the track and running context
Act 1 ShiftLeft retains native music sources
Act 1 ShiftLeft advances the music offset
Act 1 ShiftRight retains the track and running context
Act 1 ShiftRight retains native music sources
Act 1 ShiftRight advances the music offset

Act 2 ShiftRight advances the music offset
Act 3 keyboard fold changes the real field count

Act 3 ShiftLeft retains native music sources
